description: This file contains implementation of symlink and path cache handling functions, including path matching, cache management for filesystem stat checks, and removal scheduling for directories. It appears to be part of a utility or core module related to filesystem path handling in a larger project, specifically dealing with symlinks and directory checks.

methods.description: Finds the length of the longest common prefix path between two path strings, on a component basis.

methods.name: int check_leading_path(const char * name,int len,int warn_on_lstat_err)

methods.name: int has_dirs_only_path(const char * name,int len,int prefix_len)

methods.name: int threaded_has_dirs_only_path(struct cache_def * cache,const char * name,int len,int prefix_len)

methods.name: void schedule_dir_for_removal(const char * name,int len)
methods.description: Schedules directories and their parent directories for removal, with handling to preserve or remove based on directory hierarchy.

methods.name: void remove_scheduled_dirs(void)
methods.description: Removes all directories scheduled for removal.

methods.name: void invalidate_lstat_cache(void)
methods.description: Resets the default cache, invalidating cached path info.

methods.description: Removes a directory and invalidates cache if removal is successful.
